title: Pure Diabolos
summary: The Lair of Darkness Tribute-control build centered on Darkest Diabolos, Lord of the Lair, the Ladies of Lament, and the Virus Normal Traps. Lair of Darkness turns every monster on the field into DARK and lets you Tribute an opponent's monster once per turn to pay for your own effects.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ahrima, the Wicked Warden discards itself to search Lair of Darkness, or Tributes a DARK monster on the field to draw a card (or search Darkest Diabolos if you Tributed a monster other than itself).
Lilith, Lady of Lament Tributes a DARK monster as a Quick Effect to reveal 3 Normal Traps from the Deck and Set the opponent's choice directly to your field.
Alice, Lady of Lament searches any Fiend whose combined ATK and DEF equal 2000—Lilith or Malice—when Tributed or destroyed.

summary.title: Opening: Ahrima + Lilith, Lady of Lament
steps: Discard Ahrima, the Wicked Warden to search Lair of Darkness and activate the Field Spell so all face-up monsters become DARK.

Normal Summon Lilith, Lady of Lament; on the opponent's turn, use her Quick Effect under Lair of Darkness to Tribute an opponent's monster as cost and Set Eradicator Epidemic Virus, Deck Devastation Virus, or Ballista Squad from the Deck.

Whenever a DARK monster you control is Tributed, Darkest Diabolos, Lord of the Lair Special Summons itself from your hand or GY and Tributes a DARK monster to place a card from the opponent's hand on the top or bottom of their Deck.

summary.title: Darkest Diabolos & Lair Recursion
summary.text: Darkest Diabolos, Lord of the Lair has 3000 ATK and 2000 DEF, cannot be Tributed by the opponent, and cannot be targeted by card effects. In each End Phase, Lair of Darkness summons Torment Tokens equal to the number of monsters Tributed that turn, giving Darkest Diabolos, Lilith, and Malice, Lady of Lament fresh Tribute fodder. Malice Tributes 2 monsters as a Quick Effect to Set a banished or GY Normal Trap back to your field, while Diabolos, King of the Abyss rearranges the top card of the opponent's Deck before their Draw Phase.

summary.title: Virus Traps & Disruption
points: Eradicator Epidemic Virus Tributes Darkest Diabolos or an opponent's 2500+ ATK monster under Lair of Darkness to destroy all Spells or all Traps on the opponent's field, in their hand, and in their next 3 draws.

Deck Devastation Virus Tributes a 2000+ ATK DARK monster to wipe out all 1500 or less ATK monsters and handtraps, while Full Force Virus Tributes a 2000+ DEF DARK monster to destroy all 1500 or less DEF monsters.
Ballista Squad Tributes an opponent's monster under Lair of Darkness to destroy a second card they control, removing two cards at once.
Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres Tributes itself from the Extra Monster Zone to bounce a face-up card and trigger Darkest Diabolos in the GY.

allow.Terraforming: Searches the essential Lair of Darkness Field Spell.
allow.Eradicator Epidemic Virus: Tributes Darkest Diabolos (3000 ATK DARK) or an opponent's 2500+ ATK monster via Lair of Darkness to destroy all Spells or all Traps in the opponent's hand, field, and next 3 draws.
allow.Deck Devastation Virus: Tributes a 2000+ ATK DARK monster to destroy all 1500 or less ATK monsters in the opponent's hand, field, and next 3 draws.
allow.Full Force Virus: Tributes a 2000+ DEF DARK monster to destroy all 1500 or less DEF monsters the opponent controls/draws.
allow.Ballista Squad: Normal Trap that tributes 1 monster to destroy another card the opponent controls.
allow.Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres: Link-2 Dragon that tributes itself to bounce a card and trigger Darkest Diabolos in the GY.

main: Darkest Diabolos, Lord of the Lair

Signature 3000 ATK boss that cannot be Tributed or targeted by opponent's effects, Special Summons itself from hand/GY when you Tribute a DARK monster, and tributes a DARK monster to top/bottom-deck a card from the opponent's hand.
Diabolos, King of the Abyss
Classic Level 7 DARK Dragon Diabolos that inspects the top card of the opponent's Deck before their Draw Phase and places it on the top or bottom of their Deck.
Ahrima, the Wicked Warden
Discards itself to search Lair of Darkness, and tributes 1 DARK monster on the field to either draw 1 card or search a 2000+ DEF DARK monster (Darkest Diabolos).
Lilith, Lady of Lament
Quick Effect: tributes 1 DARK monster (an opponent's monster under Lair of Darkness!) to reveal 3 Normal Traps from the Deck and Set 1 to your field.
Malice, Lady of Lament
Quick Effect: tributes 2 monsters to recycle a banished or GY Normal Trap directly to your field.
Alice, Lady of Lament
Searches any Fiend with 2000 combined ATK/DEF (Lilith or Malice) when Tributed or destroyed.
Lair of Darkness

Core Field Spell that turns all monsters on the field into DARK, lets you Tribute an opponent's DARK monster once per turn to activate your card/effect, and generates Torment Tokens during the End Phase.
Terraforming
Searches Lair of Darkness.
Eradicator Epidemic Virus
Tributes Darkest Diabolos or an opponent's boss monster to obliterate all Spells or all Traps the opponent possesses.
Deck Devastation Virus
Tributes Ahrima or an opponent's 2000+ ATK monster to wipe out all handtraps and small starters in the opponent's hand.
Full Force Virus
Tributes Darkest Diabolos or an opponent's 2000+ DEF monster to wipe out low-DEF monsters.
Ballista Squad
Tributes 1 opponent's monster (under Lair of Darkness) to destroy 1 other card they control and immediately trigger Darkest Diabolos from hand/GY.
extra: Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres
Link-2 Dragon that tributes itself to bounce a card and trigger Darkest Diabolos in the GY.
